Hi Olivia / EngOps team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good alignment on success criteria. Per our mutual action plan (linked below) I'm drafting the milestone for the load/perf run and listing the asks we need to lock a window. Please review and confirm the items in bold so we can finalize scheduling.

Quick recap (from today's discovery):
- Goal: traffic replay to validate peak-QPS latency & throughput for PureBank checkout flows (authorization + recommendations path).
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 220ms end-to-end at peak QPS; no errors > 0.5%.
- Expected peak traffic: ~7k–8k QPS during peak 1–2 minute bursts; sustained 2k QPS typical.

MAP milestone: Load/Performance Test — proposed draft items
- Target test window (please propose 2 candidate windows): *[Customer to confirm]*
- Required artifacts from FastBank: traffic capture or traffic profile CSV, traffic routing keys, sample encrypted payloads (PII redacted)
- Redwood deliverables: traffic replay harness, dedicated capacity sizing recommendation, runbook and on-call rotation
- Responsibility split: FastBank to provide capture + approved test account; Redwood to provision dedicated capacity and run traffic replay; EngOps to open firewall/whitelisting windows
- Estimated lead time: 10 business days from artifact hand-off for dedicated sizing + prep (may shorten with partial artifacts)

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP steps & milestones), replay-instructions.txt (format + encryption guidelines)
Links: https://redwood.app/drive/map/FB-2026-042

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm two candidate windows in the next 3 weeks (evening or weekend preferred)?
2) Confirm peak QPS estimate and any unexpected burst factors (e.g., multi-region spikes).
3) Assign EngOps point-of-contact for firewall whitelisting and test day coordination.

If everything looks good I will circulate an updated MAP milestone with a target close of 2026-02-05 and a checklist of pre-test deliverables.

Thanks,
Marcus

Marcus / Monica — internal sizing notes based on Olivia's numbers. Putting this here so we can confirm before sending to FastBank.

Assumptions:
- Peak target: 8k QPS (sustained short bursts, ~30–90s).
- Payload size: avg 1.1KB per request after headers (approx); this affects network egress but not e2e latency estimation much.

Preliminary dedicated capacity recommendation:
- Baseline: 2 x A100-equivalent workers (quantized model runtime) for steady-state and control-plane.
- Burst: add 2x pre-warmed burst workers (same SKU) that can be spun up in <60s for short spikes.
- Continuous batching + KV-cache warms: should target 150ms per token p95 on this stack; network adds the rest.
- Estimated per-worker qps capacity (for model-only path): ~3.5k QPS with optimized batching; so 2 baseline + 2 burst yields headroom.

Ops asks for FastBank: traffic profile CSV + 24hr sample capture (gzip) + expected concurrency per user-session. Also need their allowed IP ranges for whitelisting.

I'll prepare a one-page runbook and attach perf-metrics-template.xlsx to collect the metrics we will validate during the run. If Marcus is good with this I will convert to a short email to Olivia with the sizing summary and the runbook link.

Karthik
